responsibility: Declares the full DynamicStrings API for the boot runtime, exporting the opaque dynamic string type plus constructors, mutators, comparisons, slicing, character access, C-string conversion, and debug/allocation-checking entry points. This header is the central contract for managed Modula-2 string values and distinguishes itself from StrLib, which only manipulates caller-owned fixed character arrays.
same_name_distinction: This header exposes DynamicStrings as an opaque void *-based handle and declares the module's operations. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GDynamicStrings.cc, it hides the internal descriptor/debug structures and contains no allocation or string-manipulation implementation.
